concerns.text: T000-gen depends on T001-impl and T006c, but T001-impl is in Phase 1 (Setup) and T006c is also listed as part of Phase 2. This creates a circular dependency or an incorrect ordering; data generation should not depend on tasks within the same phase that haven't yet completed.
Similar to T000-gen, T000b-gen also depends on T001-impl and T006c, creating the same circular dependency/ordering issue.

T000-verif depends on both T000-gen AND T000b-gen, and also T001-impl. This is acceptable *if* the dependencies are executed serially (gen -> gen -> verif), but the task list doesn't enforce that order.  Without explicit sequencing, this could lead to checksumming data before it exists.

T013 depends on T009 (Data Source Adapter), which in turn depends on T000-gen and T000b-gen. This creates a long dependency chain that is vulnerable to breakage if any of the earlier tasks fail. The description states it also depends on T007d-2, but this task isn't listed as a prerequisite for T013.
T037 is marked as 'Retained but verified for executability'. This doesn’t explain *why* it was initially flagged or what verification steps were taken, making the note unhelpful.

T027e (Orchestrator) depends on T031, but T031 also feeds into T027d (Regenerator), which is then used by T027e. This creates a potential loop if validation fails and regeneration is triggered repeatedly.
